output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mint function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The transfer function does not check if the 'to' address is a contract, allowing attackers to steal arbitrary tokens.
The transferFrom function does not check if 'to' address is a contract, allowing attackers to steal arbitrary tokens.
The approve function allows attackers to increase the allowance of arbitrary users, aka the 'setAllowance' issue.
The unfreeze function allows attackers to unfreeze arbitrary tokens, aka the 'unfreezeToken' issue.
